question: Is the inherited focused Codex runner proof enough after refreshing this PR against current main, or should maintainers require live wedged Codex/WhatsApp proof before merge?
rationale: The code path still appears valid, but the PR is protected by `clawsweeper:human-review`, has an explicit proof-decision comment, and changes session/message-delivery behavior that focused tests cannot fully de-risk.

options.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
options.body: Refresh the PR against current main, preserve current abort semantics, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the focused runner regression as sufficient for the lane-release contract.

options.title: Require Live Wedge Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a live or Crabbox Codex app-server wedge demonstrates that the lane releases without corrupting session state or hiding channel delivery failures.

options.title: Close Or Rebuild Later
